QuestInfo.name: Secret Organization's Second Mission
QuestInfo.0: #p1013202#, who you've never seen before, starts talking to you... Who could this be?
QuestInfo.1: #p1013202# introduces himself as a member of the Secret Organization, then thanks you for doing a good job on the first mission. Now, he needs you to do something else. Your second mission is to eliminate the #rDecaying Coolie Zombies#k at the Forest of the Dead, collect the #b#t4000593#s#k, deliver them to #b#p2022003##k, and take what he gives you in return...\n\nYou can enter the Forest of the Dead from the open door located at the right side of the bottom floor of the Chief's Residence.
QuestInfo.2: When you gave the #t4000593#s to #p2022003#, he gave you one #t4032471#, then laughed eerily.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
32,301 EXP

0.0: Hello, Evan. I hope I didn't startle you. I'm not a suspicious person, trust me. We're both members of the same organization.\r\n#L0##bAre you #p1063018#'s master?#l\n#k
0.1: Ah, you're talking about Francis, but no, that's not me. I'm much higher up than him. In fact, I'm the one that gave you the mission in #m200000000#.\r\n#L0##bYou mean the note in the #p2012034#?#l\n#k
0.2: Yes, that was me. Thanks for the Growth Accelerant you sent. It was a huge help.\r\n#L0##bAhh, it's really no big deal.#l\n#k
0.3: No, no. You're not even an official member and you're already a huge asset. Almost everyone knows about you. I feel that I can definitely trust you with this next mission.\r\n#L0##bOh, you have something for me already?#l\n#k
0.4: That's correct. This one is way more difficult than the last one, I'll admit, but I think you can handle it. The #rDecaying Coolie Zombies#k in the Forest of the Dead in #b#m211000000##k need to be dealt with, and we need #b#t4000593##k...\r\n#L0##bWhat? Forest of the Dead? Zombies? I dunno about this...#l\n#k
0.5: Believe me, this is of the utmost importance. We need you to get #b150 #t4000593#s#k and bring them to #b#p2022003##k in the underground of #m211000000# #m211000001#. #p2022003# will have your reward.\r\n#L0##bHrmm... Okay. Since it's that important...#l\n#k
0.6: Brilliant. I'll send you to #m211000000# when you're ready. To get to the Forest of the Dead, enter through the #ropen door on the right side of the lowest floor in the Chief's Residence#k.\r\n#b#e<You will be moved to the Chief's Residence when you accept.>#n#k

no.0: That's too bad... The organization would be much better off if we had more people like you. Can you please think about it again? For the sake of Maple World?

1.0: I suppose you're the one that they've sent. Kekeke. You look kind of dumb, if you ask me. Well, that doesn't matter. All I need to do is take what I need and give you what I'm supposed to give you, right?

yes.0: Kekekeke! Here's what you were promised. I don't want to hear you talk about anything else. Kekeke!

item.0: You're lost, aren't you? I'm telling you! You can enter the Forest of the Dead through the rightmost door that is slightly open on the bottom floor of Chief's Residence. It's not that complicated...
